BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning permissible use of force by law enforcement and correctional officers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to permissible use of force by law enforcement and correctional officers; adding a new section to chapter 10.31 RCW; repealing RCW 10.120.010, 10.120.020, 10.120.030, 43.101.450, and 43.101.490; and repealing 2021 c 324 s 1 (uncodified).

BillSectionHeader.P: The following acts or parts of acts are each repealed:

BillSection.P: 2RCW 10.120.020 (Permissible uses of force) and 2021 c 324 s 3;
3RCW 10.120.030 (Policies for use of force and de-escalation tactics) and 2021 c 324 s 4;
4RCW 43.101.450 (Violence de-escalation training) and 2021 c 324 s 6, 2019 c 1 s 3 (Initiative Measure No. 940), & (2018 c 11 s 3 (Initiative Measure No. 940) repealed by 2019 c 4 s 8); and

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 3. A new section is added to chapter 10.31 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: If after notice of the intention to arrest the defendant, he or she either flee or forcibly resist, the officer may use all necessary means to effect the arrest.
